Definition: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to blame:--find fault.
BiblicalUsage: Memphomai means to find fault, to blame, and it cuts both ways in the New Testament. Hebrews 8:8 says God found fault with the people, and promised a new covenant, and Romans 9:19 has the objector ask, why doth He yet find fault, for who hath resisted His will?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the difference is who is doing the blaming: God finds fault to make a new covenant, and man finds fault to excuse himself.
